verdict.rationale: Cursor documents account sign-in through a browser flow, with no key needed (the ACP auth method is "cursor_login"). Its own API keys are an optional add-on, which implies built-in model access through the account. A free tier is only indirectly evidenced, by community reports that users create new accounts to get more usage. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a free tier and its limits, explicit docs that built-in model access needs no API keys, hands-on corroboration of free-tier sign-in.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Use the browser flow for the easiest authentication experience
You can add your own API keys so Cursor uses your preferred AI models.
users create new accounts to get unlimited use
